title: AI-editable IFC-aligned home model
description: Canonical parametric authoring graph for a home. Rendered meshes and CAD shapes are derived artifacts.

HostPlacement.description: A right-handed local frame on an authored host surface. Offsets are local millimetres; rotations are intrinsic XYZ degrees.

Length.description: Length in the project length unit, fixed to millimetres in model version 0.1.

UnitVec2.description: A semantic validator must verify that this vector has unit length.

UnitVec3.description: A semantic validator must verify that this vector has unit length.

LocalLoop2.description: Closed loop in an element-local 2D coordinate system; the closing point is implicit.

LocalProfile2.description: Profile in an element-local 2D coordinate system.

station.description: Distance along the host path from its start.

stationReference.description: Which horizontal point of the opening is located at station.
